performance_case.causal_mechanism: A fixed complete-UTC-day BTC shock may create a repeatable short-horizon market-path state, but only deterministic point-in-time anatomy and later independently accumulated outcomes can distinguish continuation, reversal, or risk clustering from a hindsight story.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may freeze only the event, attribution, source-time, promotion, and single-clock integration boundaries for one later implementation slice. It cannot inspect new outcomes, explain a real market day, select a feature or strategy, implement code, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy, or change any schedule, server, source, canonical state, or Trading path.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A later separately preregistered matched-capital experiment could test whether a point-in-time post-shock state avoids disproportionate adverse paths without excessive missed gains, but all drawdown value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded detector can turn rare large moves into structured learning while R1 and R2 mature, but an unrestricted daily news narrative would consume LLM time, duplicate closed volatility work, and create false causal confidence. The design must preserve the cheaper deterministic path lane and close if causal distinctness or point-in-time evidence is not supportable.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The design audit cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly. Its potential value is reducing time to accept or reject one independently testable post-shock mechanism without lowering the 3% trigger, mining neighboring definitions, or converting after-the-fact explanations into tradable evidence.
